report.answer_text:
David Szalay won the 2025 Booker Prize for his novel *Flesh*.
*Flesh* was named the winner at a ceremony in London on Monday, 10 November.[1]
The prize is worth £50,000.[2]
Szalay is the first Hungarian-British writer to win the Booker Prize.[3]
He had been shortlisted once before, in 2016, for *All That Man Is*. This year he beat Susan Choi, Katie Kitamura, Ben Markovits, Andrew Miller and Kiran Desai.[2]
The judging panel was chaired by Roddy Doyle, who won the prize in 1993.[1]
The separate International Booker Prize for 2025 went to Banu Mushtaq and her translator Deepa Bhasthi. They won for *Heart Lamp*.[4]
